授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
人類は地球上に形作られた環境を利用しながら日々の生活を営んでいます。
しかしその環境の成り立ち：ストーリーをきちんと理解している人はどれくらいいるでしょうか？例えば、山脈はどのように形成されるのか？や、毎日飲む水はどこから来ているのか？地域の人々がどのように自然を利用して生きているのか？等。地理学はそうした私達をとりまく環境の諸要素（海、山、水、土、地形等）と人々の営みを理解する学問分野です。今後、旅行したい場所はありますか？もしあればその場所の地理を理解していれば、旅はもっと面白いものになります。
とはいえ地理学に触れたことのない人も多いと思うので、なるべく分かりやすく、取っ付き易い講義にします。具体的には、私が調査を行ってきた南太平洋やアフリカ、東南アジアでの実際の写真・映像や、ジブリ作品（天空の城ラピュタ、もののけ姫等）やディズニー作品（モアナ）から地理学を学びます。そして日本のみならず世界の人々が地域固有の自然の上でどのような生活を営んでいるのかについて概観し、自然⇔人類との繋がりを自ら考察できる能力の獲得を目指します。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Human beings live their daily lives while making use of the environments that have been formed on Earth.
But how many people truly understand how those environments came into being—the stories behind them? For example, how are mountain ranges formed? Where does the water we drink every day come from? How do local people make use of nature in order to sustain their lives? Geography is the academic field that seeks to understand both the various elements of the environment surrounding us—mountains, water, soil, landforms, and so on—and the activities of human beings within it. Is there anywhere you would like to travel in the future? If so, understanding the geography of that place will make your journey far more interesting.
That said, many people may have had little or no prior exposure to geography, so this course is designed to be as clear, accessible, and approachable as possible. Specifically, students will learn geography through actual photographs and videos from my fieldwork in the South Pacific, Africa, and Southeast Asia, as well as through Studio Ghibli films such as Castle in the Sky and Princess Mononoke, and Disney’s Moana. The course provides an overview of how people in Japan and around the world live in ways closely connected to the distinctive natural environments of their regions, and aims to develop students’ ability to think critically about the relationship between nature and humanity.
